classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0070401) and NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0070402), characterize each set with sequence analysis, gather supporting literature on NAD(P)HX repair biology, and produce a ranked list of representative sequence candidates using available VPA tools.
assumptions: GO:0070401 corresponds to ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0070402 corresponds to NADPHX epimerase activity in the Gene Ontology molecular function aspect; both are established terms for the NADHX/NADPHX metabolite damage repair enzyme subfamily.
Retrieval is restricted to reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entries to maximise annotation quality; expanding to unreviewed entries would increase coverage at the cost of annotation reliability.
Electronically inferred annotations (IEA) are excluded to focus on experimentally or manually curated associations.
Sequence analysis is performed at physiological pH 7.4, appropriate for characterising these cytosolic repair enzymes.

rank_designs will score and rank candidates using physicochemical metrics, annotation completeness, and liabilities surfaced by sequence_analysis, since no explicit ranking criteria (e.g., thermostability target, specific activity threshold) were provided.
Literature search runs in parallel and provides functional context for result interpretation but does not block or gate the ranking step.

If either GO term returns zero reviewed sequences, the corresponding sequence_analysis node will receive an empty FASTA and report accordingly; assumptions about GO term mapping should be revisited in that case.
No organism or taxon scope was requested; retrieval spans all species in reviewed UniProt to capture maximal diversity of NAD(P)HX repair enzymes.

success_criteria.go_dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences node for GO:0070401 returns a non-empty fasta_path with reviewed UniProt sequences
success_criteria.go_epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_sequences node for GO:0070402 returns a non-empty fasta_path with reviewed UniProt sequences
success_criteria.sequence_analysis_complete_dehydratase: seq_analysis_dehydratase produces metrics, representative_sequences, and liabilities for the dehydratase set
success_criteria.sequence_analysis_complete_epimerase: seq_analysis_epimerase produces metrics, representative_sequences, and liabilities for the epimerase set
success_criteria.literature_context_available: lit_nadphx_repair returns at least one record with abstract covering NAD(P)HX repair mechanisms
success_criteria.ranked_candidates_produced: rank_candidates returns a ranked_candidates list and ranked_tsv artifact covering both enzymatic activity classes

inputs.query: NADPHX NADHX repair dehydratase epimerase metabolite damage enzyme
